news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Re-Evaluation as Streaming Platforms Cut Budgets
news.summary: The Tollywood film industry is experiencing a significant shift as OTT platforms slash acquisition budgets and tighten financial offers. Streaming services are increasingly tying payouts to theatrical performance, creating a gap between producer expectations and actual deals. This ongoing trend forces filmmakers to prioritize controlled budgets and dependable box-office returns rather than relying on streaming safety nets.
